verdict.summary: Customer ad-account access requires a verified business plus App Review approval for Full access to ads_read and/or ads_management. Plan around a development-only launch first: Full Marketing API access also requires 500+ API calls in 15 days with an error rate below 15%, and Meta publishes no review timeline.
verdict.activeEffort: Create and configure the app, complete Business Verification, build a reviewer-accessible OAuth flow, request per-permission advanced access, and generate reliable development-tier Marketing API usage.
verdict.waitTime: Unstated; Meta's reviewed documentation gives no Business Verification or App Review processing-time SLA.
verdict.mainGate: Business Verification and App Review for Full access to customer ad accounts, followed by Marketing API tier qualification.

steps.title: Register as a Meta developer and create the app

detail.text: You must be registered and logged in as a Meta developer, then create the app from the app-creation flow with an app name and contact email.

sources.quote: To create an app with Meta, you must first register as a developer and be logged into your developer account.
Navigate to **[https://developers.facebook.com/apps/creation/](https://developers.facebook.com/apps/creation/)** to begin the app creation process.
Enter your **app's name** and a **contact email address**.

detail.text: Select only compatible use cases you intend to support, because use cases cannot be removed after app creation.

sources.quote: **Use cases cannot be removed** after you create your app.

detail.text: Connect the app to a business portfolio because an app connecting customers' ad accounts accesses data the app owner does not own or manage.

sources.quote: If your app will access data that you don't own or manage, you must connect your app to a business portfolio.

steps.title: Add Facebook Login and Marketing API

detail.text: Adding the Marketing API product gives the app Limited tier access by default.

sources.quote: When you add the Marketing API product in your [App Dashboard](https://developers.facebook.com/apps), you will get the **Limited tier** of Marketing API Access Tier by default.

detail.text: Enter every callback under Facebook Login Client OAuth Settings. Each redirect URI must exactly match the registered URI, including query parameters except state; use state for dynamic post-login destinations.

sources.quote: Verify the **Valid OAuth redirect URIs** in the **Client OAuth Settings** section.
The full URI must be an exact match, including all parameters, with the exception of the optional state parameter, the value of which is ignored.
For apps with **dynamic redirect URIs**, use the [state parameter](https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/facebook-login/guides/advanced/manual-flow#logindialog)

steps.title: Validate redirect-URI design and OAuth scope rationale

detail.text: Prepare a fixed redirect-URI allowlist, state-handling design, and least-privilege justification for public_profile plus ads_read and/or ads_management.

sources.quote: `scope`. A comma or space separated list of [Permissions](https://developers.facebook.com/docs/facebook-login/permissions) to request from the person using your app.
If you're managing someone's ads, use the `scope` parameter to prompt them for the `ads_management` or `ads_read` permissions.

detail.text: Use ads_read for read-only customer-ad-account workflows and ads_management only where the product manages ads; public_profile is always required.

sources.quote: If you're managing someone's ads, use the `scope` parameter to prompt them for the `ads_management` or `ads_read` permissions.
The `public_profile` permission is always required and greyed out because it can't be disabled.

steps.title: Build and test the OAuth flow with app-role access

detail.text: Build and test the OAuth authorization-code flow after credentials exist, using app-role users because App Review is required before people without an app or connected-business role can use the app.

sources.quote: It is required if your app will be used by people without a role on your app or a role on the business that is connected to your app.

steps.title: Do not rely on newly created test users

detail.text: Plan testing around existing app-role users: apps are limited to 10 test users and Meta says new test-user creation is temporarily unavailable.

sources.quote: Apps are limited to 10 test users.
We are temporarily removing the ability for apps to create new test users.

detail.text: Treat Limited access as development-only. Under ads_management, development tier starts at 300 requests per hour per ad account plus active-ad scaling; its API-level maximum score is 60 and reaching it causes a 300-second block.

sources.quote: Heavily rate-limited per ad account. For development only. Not for production apps running for live advertisers.
`ads_management` - For each ad account in a one-hour time period: (100000 if your app is in the Marketing API Full access or 300 if your app is in the Dev tier) + 40 * Num of Active ads.
Your maximum score is 60.
You will be blocked for 300 seconds if you reach the maximum score.

detail.text: Complete Business Verification for advanced permission access and for an app that lets other businesses access their own data. Start from App Dashboard Settings > Basic > Verification, then finish the process in Facebook Business Manager.

sources.quote: Apps that request advanced access for permissions and apps that allow other Businesses to access their own data must be connected to a Business that has completed Business Verification.
Load your app in the App Dashboard and go to **Settings** > **Basic** > **Verification** and click the Start Verification button
the verification process itself must be completed in the Facebook Business Manager.

detail.text: Draft the privacy policy, permission-by-permission data-use and user-benefit explanations, reviewer instructions, and a reviewer test-flow script.

sources.quote: App Review consists of six components - verification, app settings, allowed usage, data handling, data protection, and reviewer instructions.
The app settings section will require you to upload your app icon, your privacy policy URL, app category, and business email.
You will be asked to describe how your app will use the data tied to the permissions requested and how it may enhance the user experience.

steps.title: Submit each required permission for advanced access

detail.text: In App Review > Permissions and Features, request advanced access for ads_read and/or ads_management individually; approval is evaluated per permission and feature.

sources.quote: Advanced access must be approved through the App Review process on an individual permission and feature basis.
Find the permission or feature you would like to access and, under Action, click Request advanced access.

detail.text: Give reviewers usable access instructions and any required test credentials or payment codes.

sources.quote: Examples of information may include: specifics on which locations your app is accessible, provision of test credentials and/or payment codes to enable app access.

detail.text: Meta's reviewed official documentation does not state a Business Verification or App Review processing-time SLA.

steps.title: Qualify for and obtain Full Marketing API access

detail.text: Generate at least 500 Marketing API calls in the prior 15 days while keeping the error rate below 15% for the last 500 calls, then upgrade through App Review. The newer May 2026 changelog says the qualification threshold was lowered from 1,500 to 500 calls and that screen recording is no longer required for tier-upgrade submissions.

sources.quote: Your app needs 500+ Marketing API calls in the past 15 days and an error rate below 15% for the last 500 calls.
- Auto-approval threshold lowered: 1,500 → 500 Marketing API calls in 15 days
- Screen recording requirement removed for tier upgrade submissions

detail.text: Monitor API errors and rate-limit use after Full access; the published API-level maximum score is 9,000, and ads_management capacity starts at 100,000 requests per hour per ad account plus active-ad scaling.

sources.quote: Your maximum score is 9000.
`ads_management` - For each ad account in a one-hour time period: (100000 if your app is in the Marketing API Full access or 300 if your app is in the Dev tier) + 40 * Num of Active ads.

gotchas.text: Strict Mode is required for all Facebook Login apps, and redirect URIs must be exact matches except for the state parameter.

sources.quote: Strict Mode keeps apps safe by preventing bad actors from hijacking your redirect. Enabling Strict Mode is required for all apps.
The full URI must be an exact match, including all parameters, with the exception of the optional state parameter, the value of which is ignored.

gotchas.text: Limited access is not suitable for a production app serving live advertisers.

sources.quote: Heavily rate-limited per ad account. For development only. Not for production apps running for live advertisers.

gotchas.text: Meta now calls the relevant Marketing API tiers Limited and Full access; older Standard and Advanced labels were renamed in May 2026.

sources.quote: - New tier labels: "Standard Access" → "Limited access" | "Advanced Access" → "Full access"
- Renamed: "Ads Management Standard Access" → "Marketing API Access Tier"

gotchas.text: Test users are capped and cannot currently be newly created; test users can only interact with app-role users or other test users.

sources.quote: Apps are limited to 10 test users.
We are temporarily removing the ability for apps to create new test users.
Test users can only interact with other test users, or real users who have an Administrator, Developer, or Tester role on the app.

whenBlocked.text: If Full access is unavailable, keep usage reliable within development limits until the app has 500+ Marketing API calls in 15 days and an error rate below 15% for the last 500 calls, then pursue the upgrade.

sources.quote: Your app needs 500+ Marketing API calls in the past 15 days and an error rate below 15% for the last 500 calls.

whenBlocked.text: If review cannot access the product, correct the reviewer instructions and provide functioning credentials or applicable payment codes before resubmitting.

sources.quote: Examples of information may include: specifics on which locations your app is accessible, provision of test credentials and/or payment codes to enable app access.

whenBlocked.text: If the app only needs internal role-based use, Business Verification is not required under the documented app-role-only exception; customer ad-account access does not fit that exception.

sources.quote: If your app will only be used by app users who have a role on the app itself you do not need to complete verification
Apps that request advanced access for permissions and apps that allow other Businesses to access their own data must be connected to a Business that has completed Business Verification.

uncertain: The reviewed official pages do not state a Business Verification or App Review processing-time SLA.
The reviewed official pages do not state whether Business Verification or App Review has a fee.
The reviewed test-user documentation does not state when new test-user creation will be restored.
The reviewed documentation does not explain whether the stated Full-tier auto-approval qualification is fully automatic in every case or whether App Review interaction can still be required.
